quick.keyboard_policy: Text: standalone neural predictions with original-v7 coverage reported. Quick: v7 legacy hybrid with original counts; v11/v12 neural-only, matching their keyboard policies.

handwriting.limitation: Test-source isolated strokes paired with validation text; prior visual-model validation/test use unknown. Source groups are not independently verified physical writers. Both language-document and stroke-source grouping uncertainties reported. No new calibration; not a captured production evaluation.

counts.meaning: Exact complete training/lexical count-bank memorization; top1/3 agree with count-mode tokens, not typing accuracy. Mean KL and total variation compare conditional probabilities; no sampling confidence interval or natural-text generalization claim. Actual release Rust INT8 export, no count input supplied.

latency.method: Actual release Rust models, six rounds of 300 requests per model/flow, alternating order, 60 warmups, alternating six contexts to force projection cache misses; includes Python pipe and serialization overhead. Quick a-code has two candidates; handwriting all 12362 classes; next-word full vocabulary top3. Desktop only, not Android, not total handwriting/keyboard latency.
